newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - July 8.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Tuesday's electronic version of The Wall Street Journal:
* Bell Atlantic 's $23 billion merger with NYNEX is being held up while federal regulators urge the companies to open their local service to competition.
* Montgomery Ward's parent company sought brankruptcy protection.
* Integrated Health Services agreed to buy RoTech for $615 million in stock.
* Federal budget gap forecasts are being slashed again.
* America Online access agreements are to be unveiled by two on-line merchants.
* British Telecom 's planned acquisition of MCI won Justice Department approval.
* News Corp CEO Rupert Murdoch said the company is exploring a "joint venture" with potential partners for its HarperCollins unit.
* Saks Holdings withdrew its $290 million bid for Barney's.
* Graduating high school seniors looking for full-time work are facing the best job market in years.
* Gold plunged as traders continued to abandon the precious metal after news that Australia's central bank sold more than 60 percent of its gold reserves.
* Nasdaq and the big board are in a heated battle to win international listings.
* Mutual funds are merging more than ever.
* A former Merrill Lynch private banker was arrested by Hong Kong's Commercial Crime Bureau.
* Microsoft 's Bill Gates met with top cable executives inm New York to pitch a new type of television set-top box.
* Pepsi-Co 's bottler in Mexico City said it will take over Pepsi's bottling operations in Monterrey.
* Indonesia's Central Bank prohibited all loans for land purchases and land development from Indonesian banks to property developers.
* British manufacturing output fell 1.1 percent in May.
* The Madrid bourse posted its fifth record in a row.
* The U.S. Treasury Bond market chugged ahead Monday.
* Some investors say slot machine maker International Game Technology and Gtech Holdings may merge.
((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610))
